naomi.release: Heads-up: I'm assembling the internal release note for Wednesday's small deployment. Scope: autoscaler backoff tuning, batching latency tweak, and a defensive model pin for model-Z to v3.0.0. Need final wording for staff email and the deploybot schedule.

ops-shift: Canary windows look fine. Recommend prod canary 30m to be safe given we touched batching. Also add a short list of rollback thresholds.

joes.docs: Draft TL;DR: "Deployment: stability fixes (autoscaler probe/backoff), batching improvement for short sequences, and fallback model-Z pin to v3.0.0. Canary followed by staged rollout."

jules.docs: I'll format the RN with sections: TL;DR, Change summary, Impact, Ops runbook. Stub below.```TL;DR
- Autoscaler backoff tunes to reduce flapping
- Batching change improves throughput for short requests (~10% median)
- Model-Z fallback pinned to v3.0.0

Change summary
- infra: increased liveness threshold and backoff
- runtime: batching threshold lowered for short inputs
- routing: fallback rule that pins model-Z to v3.0.0 for 5m on high latency

Impact
- Expected improvements in pod stability and throughput.
- Possible short-lived increase in tail latency during traffic redistribution.

Ops runbook
- Staging canary: 2026-03-24T04:00Z (15m)
- Prod canary: 2026-03-24T05:00Z (30m)
- Rollback triggers: >4% error uplift sustained over 5m OR P95 latency increase >25% over baseline for 10m
- Rollback action: `/deploy rollback release-2026-03-24` and re-pin model routes
```

oz.sre: Add quick health checks: `curl -fsS https://staging.health/ping` and `kubectl get rs -l release=release-2026-03-24 -n runtime`. If aborted, scale down RS and revert traffic.

naomi.release: Proposed deploybot command: `/deploy schedule release-2026-03-24 --canary staging:2026-03-24T04:00Z,prod:2026-03-24T05:00Z --notify eng-oncall,eng-sre --notes "autoscaler+batches+model-pin"`

Deploy Bot: Scheduled release-2026-03-24 (staging canary 2026-03-24T04:00Z, prod canary 2026-03-24T05:00Z). Ping targets: eng-oncall, eng-sre. Status: queued.

ops-shift: Please include contact list (naomi.release, oz.sre, ops-shift) and the evacuation runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/release-evac.

jules.docs: YAML model pin snippet added to RN draft:```model_pin:
  model-Z: v3.0.0
  fallback_window: 5m```

naomi.release: I'll pin the RN to #eng-releases and schedule the staff email at T-30m. jules, please finalize copy for Sales Ops (1-2 lines).

jules.docs: Sales Ops copy: "Small stability-focused deployment. No expected customer-facing changes; monitoring will run during canary." Sending to sales-ops for awareness.

Deploy Bot: Reminder scheduled: release-2026-03-24 will post internal announce at 2026-03-24T04:15Z (post-staging canary) unless canceled.

naomi.release: Thanks all. Will drop the RN link here once live and set the deploybot announce. Standby for staging canary 04:00 UTC.
